mind_map.root_node: Maps and Locations (Cardinal Directions, Grid Coordinates & Map Scale)

key_nodes: Four Main Cardinal Directions: North (N, top of map), South (S, bottom), East (E, right), West (W, left)
Sun Orientation Rule: Sun rises in East, sets in West
Opposite Cardinal Pairs: North <-> South; East <-> West
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Confusing left/right relative turn directions with fixed compass directions.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Compass Rose Rule: Clockwise sequence is N -> E -> S -> W.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Siberian crane migration path tracking, sea navigation, and hiking.

key_nodes: Four Intermediate Directions: North-East (NE), South-East (SE), South-West (SW), North-West (NW)
45° Angular Bisection: Intermediate directions bisect 90° cardinal right angles
Magnetic Compass Needle: Magnetized needle always aligns along magnetic North-South axis
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Naming intermediate directions as 'East-North' instead of standard 'North-East'.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Intermediate Direction Rule: Always lead with North or South (e.g., NE, SE, SW, NW).
sub_branches.real_world_application: Aviation flight headings, weather wind direction reporting, and maritime navigation.

key_nodes: Coordinate Pair Structure: (x, y) where x = Horizontal column index, y = Vertical row index
Origin Point: (0, 0) intersection of horizontal baseline and vertical axis
Plotting Protocol: Move x units right from origin, then y units up
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Reversing horizontal (x) and vertical (y) coordinates (plotting (x,y) as (y,x)).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Coordinate Rule: Always read (Horizontal X, Vertical Y).
sub_branches.real_world_application: City street grid navigation, seating chart locations, and GPS mapping.

key_nodes: Taxicab Grid Distance: Distance = |x2 - x1| + |y2 - y1| (blocks traveled along grid lines)
Grid Enclosed Area: Length x Width calculated from coordinate bounds
Shortest Grid Path: Multiple distinct grid paths can share equal taxicab distance
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Measuring diagonal Euclidean distance across grid blocks instead of taxicab block distance.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Taxicab Distance Formula: D = |Delta X| + |Delta Y|.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Urban delivery driver routing, robotics grid navigation, and chessboard movements.

key_nodes: Map Legend / Key: Decoding colored lines, markers, icons (e.g., Delhi Metro line colors)
Route Tracing: Identifying interchange stations and counting stop counts
Physical Map Conventions: Blue = Water bodies, Green = Forests, Brown = Mountains
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Misinterpreting line color codes on transit maps as physical track colors.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Map Legend Rule: Refer to Key legend to decode abstract line colors and markers.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Navigating subway networks, tourist sightseeing, and environmental maps.

key_nodes: Scale Reduction Factor: Ratio scaling large ground distances onto printable paper (e.g., 1 cm = 5 km)
Ground Distance Calculation: Ground Distance = Map Distance (cm) x Scale Factor (km/cm)
Map Distance Calculation: Map Distance = Ground Distance / Scale Factor
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Measuring map distance with ruler without multiplying by scale factor.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Map Scale Conversion: Ground Distance = Map Distance x Scale Factor.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Reading transit route maps, architectural floor plans, and atlas maps.
